hypothesis: Likely root cause is upstream OCR text quality (get_bctc_page_text) feeding corrupted Vietnamese label strings into the Haiku refine step, which then confidently reproduces the corruption rather than correcting it against the page image (image is only consulted for table STRUCTURE per FR-13, not for verifying label legibility). impact_severity: MED -- numeric data (used by bctc-analyst / downstream analysis) appears unaffected, but any consumer or human reviewer relying on the Vietnamese line-item labels for readability or matching would see corrupted/nonsensical text, and the confidence-gate + flags[] mechanism designed to catch refine defects does not surface this class at all (silent pass-through at 0.75-0.8 confidence).
